prompts.RushBikes: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original painted sprite atlas for a fast 2.5D motorcycle racing game inspired by mid-1990s PC racing art, no copied characters or logos. Transparent background. EXACT GRID 3 columns x 5 rows, fifteen fully isolated complete motorcycle AND human rider sprites. Each cell has generous transparent margin, all tires fully visible. Rows are five DISTINCT designs: red superbike with compact black/red racing-suit rider; blue faired sportbike white/blue rider; yellow naked street bike green/yellow rider; black cruiser brown leather rider; white/orange dirt supermoto orange rider. Human realistic proportions, compact crouching rider, substantial full-sized motorcycle, no giant torso, helmets. Columns show SAME row's bike at rear three-quarter leaning left 15 degrees, perfectly straight rear, rear three-quarter leaning right 15 degrees. Camera low behind bike slightly above seat level, long wheelbase foreshortened, visible tank, seat, swingarm, exhaust, tire sidewall, material highlights. All three poses same scale and wheel-contact baseline within each cell, pivot rear tire contact. Crisp hand painted detailed shaded forms, convincing volume, cool soft daylight, realistic materials, no cast floor shadow, NO TEXT, no grid lines. Sheet rectangular portrait, uniform cells. Important gap between rows.
prompts.RushTraffic: Use case: stylized-concept. Original detailed painted 2.5D racing game traffic sprite atlas, transparent background. EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 DISTINCT vehicle designs, each complete isolated sprite centered in uniform cell with 15% transparent margin. Row1: mustard taxi sedan, blue sports coupe, ivory panel van, red compact hatchback. Row2: olive pickup, silver estate wagon, cream city bus, purple muscle car. Row3: orange construction dump truck, teal minivan, black executive sedan, white ambulance with orange striping. View low from behind each vehicle, subtle rear three-quarter revealing right flank and roof, perspective consistent across all vehicles, wheels and rear body entirely visible. Vehicle scale relative to cell similar, heavy vehicles taller. Hand painted realistic 1990s PC/3DO racing aesthetic, polished material shading, distinct silhouettes and bumpers, rear lamps, tire tread, dark windows, no lettering/logos/watermarks, no ground shadows, no backdrop. Wide atlas 4:3.
prompts.RushBuildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Original detailed hand painted sprite atlas for a 2.5D street racing game. Transparent background. EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows, eight isolated dense urban street frontage BUILDING BLOCK sprites with wide transparent gutters, no touching cells. Row1: red brick five-story apartment shops; grey concrete seven-story offices; warm sandstone four-story corner shops with green awnings; six-story dark glass office block. Row2: two-story roadside diner with red awning; three-story mechanic garage and shutter bays; two-story cream suburban shops; low roadside gas station canopy and kiosk. Each is a full building, ground floor and roof entirely visible. Low street-level perspective, facade facing camera with right side visible receding toward vanishing point, strong 3/4 volume; visible shop windows, neon window accent lights, balconies, aircon, roof details. No pedestrians or cars. Twilight soft sky lighting with warm storefronts, painted realistic nostalgic PC racing style not pixelated, not cartoon. No text or watermark, no floor background, tiny curb base allowed. Natural architecture proportions. Wide landscape atlas.
prompts.RushHazards: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game sprite atlas transparent background. EXACT 3 columns x 2 rows, six well separated isolated assets. Row1: orange white reflective construction cone; orange striped roadwork barrier with two amber warning beacons; small yellow parked excavator seen from rear quarter with arm folded. Row2: irregular broken asphalt pothole with dark cavity exposed jagged aggregate and rubble lip, viewed from low elevated road camera; wide rectangular milled asphalt repair patch with broken crumbling edges and loose gravel, low perspective; orange water-filled road construction barricade with reflective white chevrons. Detailed painted realistic 1990s PC game texture aesthetic, subdued daylight lighting, strong volume/material detail. Every asset entirely within cell with broad transparent margins. No text no people no background, no cast shadow outside object. Road damage rendered flat on ground in shallow perspective, not upright rocks. 3:2 landscape sheet.
